stories.headline: Three Indonesian UN peacekeepers killed in Lebanon, additional soldiers injured in follow-up attack
stories.summary: Three TNI soldiers serving with UNIFIL in southern Lebanon were killed in attacks, with President Prabowo condemning the 'heinous acts' and holding memorial ceremonies. Additional soldiers were later injured in a separate incident, prompting calls for UN investigation and safety review.

stories.headline: Prabowo completes state visits to Japan and South Korea, securing $10 billion in investment commitments
stories.summary: President Prabowo concluded diplomatic visits to Japan and South Korea, bringing home business commitments worth approximately $10 billion. He received South Korea's highest state honor and signed multiple MOUs on energy cooperation, technology, and trade.

stories.headline: Government maintains fuel prices despite global oil crisis, implements work-from-home policy
stories.summary: The government announced it will not raise subsidized or non-subsidized fuel prices until end of 2026 despite soaring global oil prices due to Middle East conflicts. Prabowo also implemented work-from-home policies for civil servants on Fridays and announced plans for B50 biodiesel program.

stories.summary: Former Vice President Jusuf Kalla revealed he has submitted strategic recommendations on economic and diplomatic policies to President Prabowo, collected from activists and academics. He plans to meet directly with the President to discuss the proposals.
